suggested_new_rule.internalTitle: Disable unneeded diagnostic and telemetry services (Call Home)

suggestion.rationale: The configuration line `service call-home` maps to the specified compliance rule and data field `csm.services.call_home` because it enables the diagnostic and telemetry services, which are the very services being disabled, to send calls to a call home agent.

This CLI configuration line maps to the specified compliance rule and data field because it specifies a banner with the text "Unauthorized" and "C" (indicating the end of the banner) at the beginning and end of the string, respectively, in a line that is displayed to the user with the "csm.management" command set in the banner.
